sandbox.detail: No free dev account. Limited free test queries (no unit cost for ahrefs.com/wordcount.com targets, limit capped at 100) but need API key on a paid plan.

evidence.quote: Users on any paid plan can test Ahrefs API by running a limited set of free test queries.

rate_limits.summary: 60 requests/min by default; HTTP 429 when exceeded; plus API unit costs (min 50 units per billable request)

evidence.quote: Ahrefs API is limited to 60 requests per minute by default.
